content: Added dupl linter to golangci-lint (threshold 100) with exclusions for src/hostPhase/disks/ and src/utils/firstboot/ (intentional standalone/layout duplication)
Harness dedup: parametrized hasHealthyBtrfsRaidLayout(detail, level), extracted formatCheckTable(), extracted buildBinary() in firstboot.go. Zero dupl findings.
swap_test.go: TestParseSwapSizeMiB 1T/1P now expect error (32 GiB maxSwapMiB cap). 26/26 pass.
Dedup session: dupl linter enabled, harness DRY fixes, firstboot DRY, lint PASS both src/ and harness/. review.md + AGENTS.md updated.
Completed code review: review.md deleted, all P0+P1+dedup done. Remaining: P2 security testing (gosec, govulncheck, dependency scan).

Session: dupl linter added, harness dedup (RAID parametrized, formatCheckTable extracted, buildBinary shared), fixtures added (btrfs_standard_server_full_stack.yaml), sysctl allowRe, emoji fix (🟢/🔴), review.md completed and deleted. Merge develop→main.
Added govulncheck to pre-commit hooks. gosec already in golangci-lint. govulncheck finds stdlib CVEs with reachability analysis. Both open source (Apache 2.0 + BSD 3-Clause).
govulncheck: src/ has 3 stdlib vulns (os, os/exec), harness/ has 37 (crypto/tls, net/http etc). All stdlib — fix by upgrading Go from 1.22.x to latest. No application code vulnerabilities.

Session: added niri desktop packages (cosmic-files/edit/screenshot, okular, eog, cosmic-player, libreoffice, galculator, firefox, thunderbird, cups, firewalld, gnome-firmware, rclone+rclone-ui). Created podman feature (rootless containers) and webmin feature (web admin with 8 modules). Removed wl-clipboard (DMS native). Created docs: webmin.md, podman.md. Updated variables.md, guides/README.md.
